query: How can narrative arts methods (poetry, storytelling, participatory theater) be integrated systematically to refine items and validate latent classes in mixed-methods work?

response.query: How can narrative arts methods (poetry, storytelling, participatory theater) be integrated systematically to refine items and validate latent classes in mixed-methods work?
response.answer: Narrative arts methods can refine mixed-methods items through storytelling and participatory theater to enhance qualitative data validation and latent class identification. These methods provide rich, contextual insights that complement quantitative data. They help uncover underlying themes and patterns.
